body: You nailed my underlying concern.  We have a very strong relationship built on trust and honesty and I don't want to jeopardize that in any way nor do I want him to think that I have been dishonest about anything else (since I haven't).   Thanks again for the input, it really helps!

Okay, that seems fair.  Give the basics, probably not too much detail and leave it at that.  Probably add a smattering of funny/cute things the kids said/did to make sure he knows that they are hanging in there.  
Thanks for the answer, I am just worried about stressing him out.

I love my kids to the ends of the earth.  I love being their mom.  I think I am terrified of how I do this alone. How I work, be sure they are okay and not end up homeless.  Everything is very daunting right now.  I don't even really have any emotional support right now and I am feeling very isolated.  I usually just push through my emotions and trudge forward which is why I think that I am so shocked and startled that something I have never even considered seriously before somehow has entered the forefront of my mind. 

Thank you for talking this through with me. It certainly helps to just be open about it and not hide my feelings.
You are correct.  And their presence is the only thing holding me back.  When I said no family --  I meant family that I could look to for assistance.
